provenance: Independent wrapper around standard std::vector using explicitly initialized anonymous union and empty outer destructor. No third-party implementation transferred.

contract: Only final vector destruction is omitted. Growth and direct helper assign/erase/clear use ordinary vector behavior. Class-level copy/swap/reset temporaries can still retain final arrays. Fast requires that final destructors/resource recovery are not needed; exception restoration not promised. Normal RAII unchanged.

measurement.flags: C++23 O2 SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS for all normal/buffer/unreleased comparisons.
measurement.isolation: Parent coordinated all peers/compilation stop for raw window.
measurement.controls: normal_control and buffer_control execute exact same binaries as respective baselines.
measurement.main: 8 existing Verify drivers, same common fast_io, same operation order and input files; identical global timer added to all. No batching/adaptation.
measurement.api: Four public growth workloads with deterministic ordered RNG calls, small repeated construction and large single construction. Build/query/complete clear+destruction phases; full child CPU/wall includes complete process exit.
measurement.CPU_wall_RSS: os.wait4 gives each child user+system and ru_maxrss; perf_counter wall from Popen through wait4. Thread clocks inside main/phases.
measurement.rss_units: KiB on this Linux host; e.g144312KiB=140.9296875MiB.
measurement.rss_limitation: Pre-exec fork image inherits Python parent memory. Floor rose roughly21–33MiB as log grew. RSS below36MiB is excluded from memory conclusions. Large Aho/SAM/PAL peaks are well above floor; no RSS retake used.
measurement.output_agreement: All1440 corresponding Verify digests and API hashes match.

validation.raw_note: One obsolete Clang ownership fixture expected an allocation call that C++ may elide; assertion corrected to semantic lifetime/final-retention checks. Six older GCC ownership passes superseded. Final120 rows all passed.
